Consequently aliases=[mv_weights]; aliases[0](x), aliases={'m': mv_weights}; aliases['m'](x), obj.__dict__['mv_'+'weights'](x), and obj.__getattribute__('mv_'+'weights')(x) all invoke the forbidden mapped symbol while forbidden_import_prefixes_clean, mapped_production_symbol_calls_clean, and dynamic_import_and_codegen_clean are all true.
